title: Report a run ended input
description: The runtime finished a Running run with an outcome. When the runtime fails after the run started, the daemon issues this command with the outcome `runtime-failure` and, just before, writes the run event `runbook.runtime-failed` (record: reason) as a RecordRunEvent of its own.

sdc.daemon.RunId.title: RunId
sdc.daemon.RunId.description: The id of a run. The daemon mints it (a UUID, version 7) in the HTTP handler and returns it in the answer to the submit; the handler fills the `run_id` input of SubmitRun and a client never chooses it. The state directory of the run is named after it. A run id that is already taken cannot occur, because the daemon mints it; the specification has no refusal for it.

sdc.daemon.RunOutcome.title: RunOutcome
sdc.daemon.RunOutcome.description: Open text: the outcome name of the runbook's protocol for the root case, or one of the daemon's own causes (`orphaned`, `runtime-failure`). The run's state is the closed set; the outcome is not.
